missed_steps.title: It answers
missed_steps.text: Unanswered calls forward to your AI line. It greets callers by your business name and asks what's going on. Hang-ups get a text back within a minute.

missed_steps.title: It asks the right questions
missed_steps.text: Name, callback number, address or ZIP, job type, urgency. Emergencies like a gas smell get a 911 instruction first and an urgent alert to you.

missed_steps.title: It books, you get a text
missed_steps.text: Only real openings from your calendar, inside your service area and time windows. You get the lead by text and email, plus a daily summary.

demo.title: Be the customer. See what your callers would get.
demo.lead: Pick a situation and tap the replies. This is a scripted demo of the text conversation after a missed call.

pricing.note: Adding a second location, Spanish, or a direct Jobber connection? Each add-on has a fixed price, listed below.

faq.a: You choose the emergency keywords (gas smell, carbon monoxide, flooding, no heat with a baby at home). If there may be danger to life, the caller is told to hang up and call 911 first. Otherwise you get an URGENT text right away, and it can ring your cell.

faq.q: Does it work with Jobber, Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan?
faq.a: Booking into Google Calendar or Calendly is included, and so is 1 Zapier webhook for any other tool. A direct Jobber, Housecall Pro, GoHighLevel or HubSpot connection is a {price:ADD-CRM.setup} add-on ({price:ADD-CRM.monthly}/mo). ServiceTitan gets a custom quote.
